'''Thale Dustrunner''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer of the [[Corellian Security Force]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We've got the snitches badge. I want you to take it to Corellia and meet with his superiors. They likely don't know him on sight. Find out what's going on.|[[Borvo's guard]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BGATTC" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Thale Dustrunner was the CorSec [[Captain/Legends|captain]] assigned to [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. He was involved in a CorSec investigation against the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Borvo]].<ref name="SWG:BGATTC" /> During the investigation, Captain Dustrunner arrested the criminal known as [[Aldalad]] for buying illegal weapons to Borvo, and convinced him to testify against the Hutt.<ref name="SWG:BC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Bluffing CorSec|Corellia}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the CorSec investigation against Borvo the Hutt came to an end when a spacer working for Borvo murdered the infiltrated CorSec agent [[Niksel Frangee]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During the six years in infiltration, all of Frangee's direct superiors had retired and been replaced. Thus, nobody in the CorSec knew how Frangee looked like at the moment of his death, the spacer used Frangee's CorSec badge to pass himself off as Frangee on Corellia. The spacer met Dustrunner in the [[Coronet Capitol]] and the CorSec officer completely fell for the ruse and took the spacer for the long lost agent.<ref name="SWG:BGATTC" /> Captain Dustrunner ordered the "agent" to protect Aldalad, the witness who wanted to testify against Borvo, and [[Maerzen]], who had discovered evidence against Borvo the Hutt. The spacer killed both of them in the [[Riverlands]], without Dustrunner suspected anything. Thale Dustrunner then asked Borvo's spy to deliver the evidence against Borvo retrieved from Maerzen to evidence storage. The spacer just left Corellia with the evidence, including Borvo's confiscated money, and brought it back to [[Borvo's guard]] on Naboo. Because of Dustrunner's ineptitude, the CorSec lost both its witness and its evidence against Borvo, making impossible to continue any investigation.<ref name="SWG:BC" /> Humiliated, Thale Dustrunner later issued an arrest warrant for the spacer to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities but the spacer escaped.<ref name="SWG:BtH">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Borvo The Hutt|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Thale Dustrunner was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BGATTC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Thale Dustrunner was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Borvo the Hutt questline (pre-NGE)|Borvo the Hutt's questline]].<ref name="SWG:TD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Thale Dustrunner|Corellia}}</ref> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Borvo the Hutt's questline was [[W:c:swg:Borvo the Hutt questline|revamped]]. While the gameplay of the questline was extensively upgraded, the storyline remained similar.<ref name="SWG:BGATTC" />
